- MCP server and web-chat merged into this repo under `cmd/mcp-server/` and `cmd/web-chat/`
- All 3 binaries built and deployed by single `deploy.yml` workflow
- safecast-map-MCP repo archived on GitHub
- Build all: `go build -o safecast-new-map . && go build -o safecast-mcp ./cmd/mcp-server/ && go build -o safecast-web-chat ./cmd/web-chat/`

## CloudFront + Nginx Routing (Mar 2026)
- ✅ MCP server: `https://simplemap.safecast.org/mcp-http`
- ✅ Swagger docs: `https://simplemap.safecast.org/docs/`
- ✅ Web-chat: `https://simplemap.safecast.org/assistant/`
- SSL cert includes both `simplemap.safecast.org` and `origin-simplemap.safecast.org`
- Nginx config: `/etc/nginx/sites-available/origin-simplemap.safecast.org`
- **CRITICAL:** Use specific `location = /api/endpoint` rules for MCP, NOT a broad `location /api/` — a broad rule breaks map-server routes like `/api/auth/` and `/api/spectrum/`
- See `docs/cloudfront-mcp-setup.md` for full routing table

## User Upload Tracking (Feb 2026)
- ✅ Uploads are linked to logged-in users via `internal_user_id` field in uploads table
- Profile page shows user's upload history at `/profile`
- Migration: `migrations/link_historical_uploads_to_users.sql` links historical Safecast imports to users
- Local dev server config: `local-server-config.sh` (has all credentials and settings)

```bash
./safecast-new-map \
  -db-type pgx \
  -db-conn "postgres://postgres:PASSWORD@127.0.0.1:5432/safecast?sslmode=disable" \
  -safecast-realtime \
  -admin-password "test123" \
  -safecast-fetcher \
  -smtp-host "smtp.gmail.com" \
  -smtp-port 587 \
  -smtp-username "oudendijk.biz@gmail.com" \

  -session-secret "YOUR_SESSION_SECRET" \
  -base-url "http://localhost:8765" \
  -allow-registration

- Admin Users: `http://localhost:8765/admin/users?password=test123`
- Admin Uploads: `http://localhost:8765/api/admin/uploads?password=test123`
- Admin Tracks: `http://localhost:8765/api/admin/tracks?password=test123`
